planned_works.title: Chandni Chowk Road Restoration
planned_works.description: Post-monsoon restoration of Chandni Chowk main road. Milling and re-laying of bituminous surface with improved camber for drainage.

location.landmark: Red Fort to Fatehpuri Masjid stretch

planned_works.traffic_impact: Pedestrianized zone - vehicle diversions for material transport only

planned_works.title: DJB Pipeline Relaying - Chandni Chowk
planned_works.description: Relaying of aged 450mm DI pipeline under Chandni Chowk Road. Includes 120 house service connection renewals in the heritage zone.

location.landmark: Town Hall to Gurudwara Sis Ganj

planned_works.traffic_impact: Trench excavation in pedestrian zone, shop access maintained

planned_works.title: FTTH Network Expansion - Karol Bagh
planned_works.description: Fiber-to-the-home network expansion covering 15 blocks in Karol Bagh residential area. Underground duct laying and overhead cable pulling.

location.landmark: Karol Bagh Metro to Gaffar Market

planned_works.title: Duct Repair - Connaught Place Inner Circle
planned_works.description: Repair and cleaning of existing telecom ducts along CP inner circle. Cable pulling for upgraded 10Gbps backbone capacity.

location.landmark: Block A to Block N, Inner Circle

planned_works.traffic_impact: Night work only, no daytime disruption

planned_works.title: Sewer Line Rehabilitation - Chandni Chowk
planned_works.description: Trenchless rehabilitation of 600mm sewer line using CIPP (Cured-in-Place Pipe) method under Chandni Chowk Road. Minimal surface disruption.
planned_works.traffic_impact: Manhole access points only, trenchless method

seeded_conflicts.description: 3-way conflict: Road restoration, DJB pipeline relaying, and sewer rehabilitation all targeting Chandni Chowk Road within overlapping timeframes.
